title: Practice 9: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The letter с in the infinitive form писать is replaced by the letter ш in all forms of the present tense. The letter в is inserted in all present tense forms of the verb жить. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
